story.title: Meta Muse Glimmer – Open weights 30B local coding model

draft:
I've been exploring Meta's new Muse Glimmer model, a 30B parameter local coding model. 
Muse Glimmer is an open-agentic model, meaning its weights are publicly available. 
This could democratize access to large language models. 
What potential applications do you see for this technology?
